name: zz-dbg-fit-negative-control
description: NEGATIVE CONTROL: force the debug panel back to the original fixed width:400/left:8 geometry and confirm the fit assertion FAILS. Expected result is exit 1 with #fit-pass timing out. If this passes, the fit test is not actually measuring anything.

steps.expression: (() => { const p=document.querySelector('[data-testid="debug-panel"]'); p.style.width='400px'; p.style.maxWidth='none'; p.style.right='auto'; p.style.left='8px'; return 'reverted to old geometry'; })()

(() => { const p=document.querySelector('[data-testid="debug-panel"]'); const r=p.getBoundingClientRect(); const de=document.documentElement; const vw=de.clientWidth; const overflowRight=Math.round(r.right-vw); const docOverflow=de.scrollWidth-de.clientWidth; const ok = overflowRight<=0 && docOverflow<=0 && r.width>120; const d=document.createElement('div'); d.id = ok?'fit-pass':'fit-fail'; d.style.cssText='position:fixed;width:1px;height:1px;left:0;top:0;opacity:0.01'; document.body.appendChild(d); return JSON.stringify({vw,panelW:Math.round(r.width),panelRight:Math.round(r.right),overflowRight,docOverflow,verdict:ok?'PASS':'FAIL'}); })()

steps._comment: EXPECTED TO TIME OUT — a TIMEOUT here means the assertion works
